description: This Java source file defines the class 'LegacyCommandResponseSenderImpl', which is an implementation of the 'CommandResponseSender' interface. The class is responsible for sending command response messages over an AMQP link within the Eclipse Hono framework. It includes methods for creating sender instances, sending messages, and managing AMQP link properties such as flow latency. The code manages the sending of command responses encapsulated in 'CommandResponse' objects, integrates tracing via OpenTracing, and interacts with the Hono connection infrastructure.
